children: Norwood Financial authorized a stock repurchase program for up to 550,000 shares, about 5% of its outstanding common stock.
Board adopted repurchase program to buy up to 550,000 shares, representing ~5% of issued and outstanding common stock.
Program supersedes the prior repurchase plan authorized in 2021.
Repurchases may occur in open market, private transactions, block trades, or under Rule 10b5-1 plans.
Purchases at management’s discretion subject to market conditions, stock price, capital alternatives and financial performance.
Program may be suspended, terminated or modified at any time and does not obligate the company to buy a specific number of shares.
